hypothesis: An automatically selected exact inverse-image join planner improves native program-synthesis query cost beyond strong static join planners and transfers to unseen operation families.
claim_boundary: Finite function composition and exact joins are established methods. No claim of globally novel algorithms, unbounded recursive self-improvement, or LLM-generated discovery is authorized by this experiment.

search.fitness: geometric mean native CPU ratio to fixed hybrid_rank reference, equal weight per non-saturated domain

goal_filter: Targets already present in the half-bank are excluded; a saturated domain is reported, never silently replaced.
pilot_disclosure: Engineering conformance and preliminary baseline timings were checked at seed 11 in all five families before planner selection. No final test seed was consulted.
acceptance: Every returned composition is exhaustively checked on the entire finite state domain
Exact no-solution answers are checked against the pairwise oracle on bounded conformance cases
Index construction, learning and validation costs are recorded
Final test seeds are not consulted during planner selection
A negative result against the strongest baseline must be retained
analysis: Paired per-domain speed ratios; geometric means, paired bootstrap intervals and per-family results. Discovery break-even is reported rather than hidden. Independent search reruns are required for a recursive-improver claim.
limitations: No live LLM calls; provider credentials are not configured
Candidate planner space is authored and disclosed
No manuscript claim of novelty until primary-source review and independent replication
